Name: Refund Staircases
Author: nickmartin1ee7
Description:
[b][u]Refund Staircases[/u][/b]
Ever been frustrated that your staircases are lost when you leave the mines? With this quality of life mod, staircases used in mineshafts are refunded on exit!

[b][u]FAQ
[/u][/b]
Q: ﻿Does this work in The Skull Cavern?
A: ﻿﻿Yes! It works as long as you are exiting what the game considers to be a mineshaft.
